name: Nancy S. Lacore
summary: Nancy Stewart Lacore (born 1968/1969) is an American politician and retired United States Navy officer who is the U.S. representative-elect for South Carolina's 1st congressional district. A vice admiral, she previously served as the 16th chief of Navy Reserve from 2024 to 2025 and the 93rd commandant of Naval District Washington from 2022 to 2024. She also served as the director of the Maritime Partnership Program, U.S. Naval Forces Europe/Africa/U.S. 6th Fleet, with additional duties as vice commander of U.S. 6th Fleet in Naples, Italy.
